mapper.select: SELECT id, name, data_type AS dataType, description, unit, decimal_places AS decimalPlaces, format, enum_type AS enumType, enum_source AS enumSource, 'PROJECT' AS businessTypeSource FROM om_data_type WHERE version_id = #{versionId} AND valid_flag = 1 AND del_flag = 0 ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT data_type.id, data_type.name, data_type.data_type AS basicTypeCode, data_type.unit, data_type.decimal_places AS decimalPlaces, data_type.format, data_type.enum_type AS enumType, data_type.enum_source AS enumSource FROM om_data_type data_type INNER JOIN om_ai_task task ON task.version_id = data_type.version_id WHERE task.id = #{taskId} AND data_type.valid_flag = 1 AND data_type.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY data_type.id LIMIT 500

SELECT data_type.data_type FROM om_data_type data_type INNER JOIN om_ai_task task ON task.version_id = data_type.version_id WHERE task.id = #{taskId} AND data_type.id = #{businessTypeId} AND data_type.valid_flag = 1 AND data_type.del_flag = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT data_type FROM om_data_type WHERE id = #{businessTypeId} AND valid_flag = 1 AND del_flag = 0 LIMIT 1
